en-IN.name: Jarvis Control
en-IN.summary: Voice commands for your personal control server.
en-IN.description: Check your control server status or send a focus mode command.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Jarvis Control to check status
Alexa, ask Jarvis Control to start focus mode
